query:
SELECT
            t.ip_address::text,
            t.ssh_port,
            t.ssh_username,
            COALESCE(k.private_key_path, '/opt/cybersheppard/keys/default_ed25519') as key_path
        FROM targets t
        LEFT JOIN ssh_keys k ON t.ssh_key_id = k.id
        WHERE t.id = $1 AND t.is_active = true
